headline: Iran targets US military facilities in Jordan with drones after US strikes
summary: The Iranian army used kamikaze drones to hit communication systems and fuel storage in response to US aggression.
details: The Iranian army announced on Thursday that it targeted US military facilities in Jordan using suicide (kamikaze) drones.
According to state television IRIB, the operation targeted communication systems and fuel storage facilities of the US military.
This action was described by Iran as a response to a new wave of strikes carried out by the United States on Iranian territory.
The escalation follows a series of tense exchanges and military strikes between the two nations in the region.

headline_marked: 2 [[journalists killed in road accident]] in Uttara
headline: 2 journalists killed in road accident in Uttara
summary: The victims were returning home by motorcycle after watching a World Cup football match early Thursday morning.
details: Two journalists were killed in a road accident in the Uttara area of the capital on Thursday early morning.
The victims, identified as Mohammad Rabiul Alam Raju, a staff reporter for Dainik Praner Bangladesh, and Shakibul Hasan, a staff reporter for Sangbad Diganta, were traveling by motorcycle.
The accident occurred between Jasimuddin Mor and Rajlakshmi areas when a bus crushed them.
They were rushed to Kurmitola General Hospital, where the duty doctor declared them dead.
Law enforcement agencies are currently working to identify the vehicle involved and determine the cause of the accident.
caption:
Two journalists killed in Uttara after being crushed by a bus while returning home from a football match.

Two journalists were killed in a road accident in the Uttara area of the capital on Thursday early morning.

The victims, identified as Mohammad Rabiul Alam Raju, a staff reporter for Dainik Praner Bangladesh, and Shakibul Hasan, a staff reporter for Sangbad Diganta, were traveling by motorcycle.

The accident occurred between Jasimuddin Mor and Rajlakshmi areas when a bus crushed them.

They were rushed to Kurmitola General Hospital, where the duty doctor declared them dead.

Law enforcement agencies are currently working to identify the vehicle involved and determine the cause of the accident.
